description.value: You know exactly where an augmented body still bends like flesh. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Grapple or Shove checks against creatures with cybernetic or prosthetic augmentation, since the joints and mounts are still weak points.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 circumstance bonus to Grapple/Shove This needs a target:trait predicate (real shape confirmed via pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-3/aurochs-headed.json's target:trait:orc), but no Cinderfall augmentation grants its wearer an actor-level trait for that predicate to read -- installed augmentations are items, not creature traits (confirmed absent corpus-wide during the archetype pass).
